notes.title: Devlog #06 – August Wrap-up & September Plan
notes.content: [p][b]August Summary[/b][/p][p align="start"]August did not go as I had expected.[/p][p align="start"]First of all, the crowdfunding campaign was successfully completed, and it received much more attention than I had anticipated.[/p][p align="start"]However, I spent a lot of time dealing with procedures required for the game’s release, which kept me from focusing on development itself.[/p][p align="start"]Work Time by Category[/p][list][*][p]Development: 44% [/p][/*][*][p]Crowdfunding Rewards: 25% [/p][/*][*][p]Other (administrative tasks, etc.): 31%[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]Results[/p][list][*][p]Demo updated[/p][/*][*][p]Crowdfunding project successfully completed[/p][/*][*][p]Store page opened on Stove Indie[/p][/*][*][p]Base system of Minigame C completed[/p][/*][*][p]Graphic assets (in progress)[/p][/*][*][p]Crowdfunding rewards (in progress)[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]Although I managed to complete the base system of Minigame C, it still needs refinement, and I was not able to work on the main story content.[/p][p align="start"]Therefore, September will require more intensive work.[/p][p align="start"][b]September Plans[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Complete the main story content[/p][/*][*][p]Prepare for Steam Next Fest[/p][/*][*][p]Release the Steam demo and collect feedback[/p][/*][/olist][p align="start"]For October, I’d like to complement promotional activities by polishing the game’s quality and working on additional content I’ve been planning.[/p][p align="start"]That means I need to finish as much of the main content as possible in September.[/p][p align="start"]I’ll reduce non-development activities and increase work intensity to focus on development.[/p]

notes.title: Devlog #05 – July Wrap-up & August Plan
notes.content:
[p][b]July Summary[/b][/p][p]In July, I went a step beyond the original plan of releasing the demo: I updated the demo, worked on promotional activities, and even prepared a crowdfunding project on Tumblbug. I was also able to make a small amount of progress on the main game.[/p][p][b]August Plan[/b][/p][p]Now that the demo update—which was not originally planned—is complete, I’ll focus on continuing development of the main game. My goals for August are as follows:[/p][p][/p][p]1. Implement the base system for the unfinished Minigame C (currently 75%)
2. Create graphic assets for Minigame C
3. Complete 3 stages of Minigame C and prepare them to be added to the main game
4. Begin working on main game content[/p][p][/p][p]While the overall graphic direction of Minigame C is roughly defined, it's still unclear in detail.
I expect that the main challenges will be coming up with clear visual ideas and arranging the UI layout.
The system itself is already mostly implemented.[/p][p]If I work steadily, I believe that goals 1, 2, and 3 can be completed within this month.
The main task for August will be to wrap those up quickly and move into the main game development.[/p][p]Thankfully, the number of Steam wishlists has been gradually increasing,
and I’ve received kind interest from people on Twitter and Itch.io.
Even though the Tumblbug project is still in pre-launch, the amount of attention it has received exceeded my expectations,
and it's made my daily development work feel much more enjoyable.[/p][p]I’ll do my best to return the support with a great finished game.
Thank you.[/p]
